extracted.summary: A solicitor instructed by the executors of a Chester estate valued at about £232,500 enquires about borrowing £70,000 to cover professional fees and tax while the property is sold.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of the executors; we have logged it for review. To take it further we will need confirmation of the executors' details and grant of probate status, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities (including the property valuation and any existing charges), and details of the tax and professional fees the £70,000 is intended to cover. Please also confirm the anticipated timescale for the sale of the property and provide your firm's client care and contact details. We will come back to you once we have reviewed the information provided. Nothing in this message should be taken as an offer or an indication of terms.
